entries.title: PR #80: back is the edge swipe only; form drawers drag by the grabber only
entries.summary: Turns off fullScreenGestureEnabled on detail screens so only the left-edge swipe goes back, and adds a contentPanning prop so form drawers (Log game, I'll be there, Pick a court) are dragged by the grabber only.
entries.why: You reported swipes that pop the screen while scrolling and drawers that move when they should not. Cause 1: fullScreenGestureEnabled: true on every detail screen made a sideways swipe anywhere pop the screen and cancel scrolls; PR #72 has had the same fix open since Oct 15 and was never merged, so main still has the bug. Cause 2: gorhom content panning was on for every drawer, so touching anywhere in a form dragged it down, then it snapped back.
entries.basis: Verified on the web build with a mouse drag in the Log game form (a mouse stands in for touch, not a phone test): on main the drawer moved 183px and snapped back; with the fix it stays put and the grabber still moves it. Typecheck and docs check pass. Belief: edge-swipe back is native iOS only and needs a check on your phone in the preview build. PR #80 checks (quality, docs, Vercel build) are green. The Vercel preview loads but stops at sign-in, so the drawer proof is the earlier before/after test on a build of the same code. The Expo Go preview publish was still running at 17:37 UTC; check edge-swipe back through it.
